No fix is installable: per the upstream advisory of 2026-08-05 the project did not issue releases for this issue, so the nominal fixed versions 3.6.4 (for the 3.6 branch) and 4.0.2 are both unreleased and exist only as git commits. No openssl-3.6.4 or openssl-4.0.2 tag exists upstream and conda-forge tops out at 3.6.3 / 4.0.1, so the scanner's openssl>=4.0.2 pin is unsatisfiable; moving to 4.0.1 would not help since 4.0.1 is itself in the affected range.
